title: ZXTank Accessibility
description: Learn about accessibility support for ZXTank and how accessibility features will be verified before release.
summary: Accessibility is an important part of ZXTank's development. Verified accessibility information will be published as features are tested on supported Apple devices.
heroImageAlt: Placeholder artwork representing ZXTank accessibility information during development

sections.heading: Our Approach to Accessibility
paragraphs: Accessibility is being considered throughout the development of ZXTank, alongside gameplay, controls and visual design.
Our goal is to create a game that is comfortable and enjoyable for as many players as possible while maintaining the fast-paced arcade experience that defines the ZX Series.

sections.heading: Verified Accessibility Features
paragraphs: Accessibility testing for the release version of ZXTank is still in progress.
Accessibility features will only be listed here after they have been tested and verified on supported Apple devices using the appropriate accessibility technologies.

sections.heading: Accessibility Improvements
paragraphs: As development continues, we will evaluate opportunities to improve readability, controls, visual clarity and the overall gameplay experience for a wider range of players.
Only accessibility features that have been fully implemented and verified will be documented on this page.

sections.heading: Current Status
paragraphs: ZXTank is currently in active development, so accessibility support should be considered a work in progress.
This page will be updated as testing is completed and verified accessibility features become available.
